languageModelTools.name: axis_run_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run the active Pine/PYNE script through AXIS IDE orchestration and return lastRun summary (not full plot arrays).

languageModelTools.name: axis_get_results_focus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return resultsFocusId, newestRunId, and lastRun summary for the AXIS IDE session.

languageModelTools.name: axis_chart_snapshot_meta
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return seriesKey, interval, script ids, live status for the active AXIS chart document.

notes.merge: Merge contributes.languageModelTools into package.json. Call registerLmTools(context, deps) from activate (extension.ts owned by wiring agent). Do not put languageModelTools in mcp-contributes.fragment.json.
notes.secrets: Tools return summaries only — never SecretStorage keys, never full plot/series arrays. axis_run_script uses prepareInvocation confirmation.
notes.deps: Wiring binds runScript → active-editor orchestrator path, results → ResultsFocusStore, getChartSnapshotMeta → active chart doc + live HUD.
